shown.message:
I closed story-repo's request #6. The common target set it asks for is already in Brief rev. 4, so I made no new change. The Outline's claims C1–C7 match the Brief, so the contribution statement is unchanged.

In my comment I said the Outline's "k ≤ ⌊N/3⌋" and my pool-based bound might differ. They don't: with the target set at about N/3, the pool has about 2N/3 benchmarks and ⌊|C|/2⌋ is about N/3. The comment is a little confusing but harmless.

I'm waiting on `experiment-repo` for the pre-registration note, which fixes the cell rules, the margin δ and |T|. Commitment issue #2 stays open.
